title: Korea's science and technology mutual aid association says member records were leaked in a hacking attack
date_note: Newsis (27 Nov) reports the association posted its notice on 26 Nov; the intrusion itself is reported as 8 Nov.
org: Korea Science and Technology Persons Mutual Aid Association (과학기술인공제회)
geo_basis: country stated by the source; pin at the capital, Seoul
summary: Newsis reports that the association, after an outside hacking attack on its server on 8 November, says member records, 약 21만건 in the article's words, were leaked. According to the association, financial information is not among the leaked items. The association advised members to change their website login password.
plain: A Korean mutual aid association says an outside hacking attack on its server leaked member records, 약 21만건 in the article's words. It says financial information is not among the leaked items and asks members to change their login password.
exec: The association says member records were leaked in a hacking attack; it says financial information was not among the leaked items.
action: The association advises members to change their website login password to prevent misuse of personal information and secondary harm.

evidence.quote: 외부 해킹 공격을 받아 약 21만건의 회원정보가 유출됐다.

validation.note: Only Newsis was read; it relays the association's own notice. The association's notice page was not read.
